Folks, let’s look at what happens when people completely lose respect for basic civic order, personal responsibility, and the rule of law. We saw it in Wisconsin, where a Racine County jury convicted a man named Harry Wait on Tuesday after a two-day trial, finding him guilty of two misdemeanor election fraud charges and one felony identity theft charge, though he was acquitted of a second count of identity theft. 

This is the exact result of individuals abandoning established institutions and thinking they can just take matters into their own hands. Wait, who leads a group that makes false election claims, took it upon himself back in 2022 to request the ballots of Republican state Assembly Speaker Robin Vos and Democratic Racine Mayor Cory Mason without their consent. And why did he do it? He openly admitted he did it just to try to prove that the state’s voter registration system is vulnerable. 

Let me tell you, this reckless behavior is a direct assault on social order and traditional channels of government. You cannot just go around stealing identities and requesting other people's ballots, no matter what your supposed intentions are. If we don't hold the line on basic integrity and the rule of law, our entire system collapses into chaos. It is high time we return to respecting proper authority, following the legal frameworks, and restoring true civic duty in our communities.
